dogecoin.text: Dogecoin uses a simplified variant of the hashing algorithm, Scrypt. It also uses the “proof-of-work” protocol, enabling it to receive work from other Scrypt based networks. Dogecoin mining is less power-intensive than Bitcoin algorithm SHA-256.
